FAQ

Questions, answered.

Straight answers to what operators ask us most. Anything else? Ask us on a call.

What does Akrostech do?

Akrostech is a backend operations partner. We provide dedicated teams for web development, recruitment assistance, virtual assistance, accounting assistance and legal assistance, so growing companies can scale operations without growing headcount.

Do your teams really work in my time zone?

Yes. Teams run shifts aligned to your working day — whether you are in New York, London, Sydney or Dubai — so you get live collaboration, same-day responses and attendance at your meetings rather than overnight hand-offs.

How is Akrostech different from a freelancer marketplace?

You get a dedicated, vetted team managed by us, with documented processes, backups for leave, NDAs and a single accountable partner — not a rotating cast of individual contractors you have to manage yourself.

How quickly can a team start?

Most clients have their first specialist onboarded within days of the discovery call, including NDAs, tool access and a trial task. Larger multi-role teams are typically assembled in a few weeks.

Is it safe to share sensitive data with an outsourced team?

Yes, with the right controls. Every engagement uses NDAs, role-based access, secure devices and GDPR-aware data handling. Access is limited to what each specialist needs and can be revoked at any time.

Is there a minimum contract?

Engagements are flexible and agreed in writing during onboarding. We will walk you through options on the discovery call so the commitment fits your plans.
